# IDEAL IT & IDEAL SOLUTIONS

> Premier IT Hardware, Security Surveillance, and Networking Solutions in Wayanad and Kannur, Kerala, India.

## About the Business
IDEAL IT (established in 2010) is a leading IT sales, service, and security systems provider in Wayanad and Kannur, Kerala. The company specializes in enterprise & residential CCTV camera systems, chip-level laptop & computer hardware diagnostics, structured optical fiber networks, UPS power backup, and smart home automation.

## Core Services
- **CCTV & Video Surveillance**: High-definition (HD) and IP camera systems, color night vision, 4K resolution, AI motion detection, remote smartphone monitoring, and NVR/DVR installation. Authorized installer for Hikvision, Dahua, CP Plus, Uniview, and Honeywell.
- **Computer Sales & Service**: Branded laptops (HP, Dell, Lenovo, Asus, Acer), custom desktop and gaming PC builds, precision BGA chip-level motherboard repair, SSD/RAM upgrades, and data recovery.
- **Networking & Optical Fiber**: Structured Cat6 cabling, fiber fusion splicing, server racks, managed switches, and long-range Ubiquiti / Cisco mesh Wi-Fi.
- **Smart Home & Commercial Automation**: Smart touch panels, video door intercoms, biometric attendance/access control, and automated gate systems.
- **Power Backup Solutions**: Online UPS, hybrid inverter systems, and maintenance-free tubular batteries for CCTV and critical IT equipment.
- **Authorized Brand Warranty Center (Kannur)**: Official authorized warranty service partner for Zebronics, Fingers, and Artis hardware.
